meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 让外部账号和 API 的请求都走本会话的 Iron Proxy:需要凭证时由人工审批后代填,Claude 只拿到无效占位符,不会索要、打印或保存真实 token,请求被拦时报告主机名和错误。
howto.when: 当你需要访问外部账号或 API(例如通过 gh 访问 GitHub),或请求被拦截、需要排查是哪一层拒绝时,由它接管。

say.text: 帮我连上 GitHub 账号
我对 api.example.com 的请求被 403 了,帮我看看是哪层拦的
say.note: 它会报出主机名和错误,请求主机侧检查

say.text: 用 gh 列一下我的仓库

howto.what_en: Routes external account and API calls through the session's Iron Proxy. Credentialed requests wait for human approval; Claude only sees a placeholder, never asks for or stores a real token, and reports blocks with hostname and error.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need an external account or API (such as GitHub via gh), or when a request is blocked and needs diagnosis.

say_en.note: Runs ncl groups connect --host and returns the connect_url.

say_en.text: My request to api.example.com returns 403 — help me find what blocked it
say_en.note: Reports hostname and error; asks for a host-side check.

say_en.text: Use gh to list my repositories
say_en.note: Uses gateway-managed as placeholder; no real token.
